Definition: Eljehoenai or Eljoenai, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eljehoenai or Eljoenai is the name of seven Israelites. In 1 Chronicles 3:23, the text says "Elioenai." The life behind the name is told on the Elioenai People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eljehoenai or Eljoenai matters because God knows His people by name, and Eljehoenai or Eljoenai is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
